summary: Markel Group filed an 8-K announcing Chairman Steven A. Markel's notice on September 3, 2026 that he will not stand for re-election at the 2027 Annual Meeting and will retire as Chairman upon a successor's appointment. Effective September 8, 2026, the Board appointed CEO Thomas S. Gayner as Chairman, and named Simon Wilson and Andrew G. Crowley Co-Presidents, with base salaries raised to $1,210,000, $1,083,520 (GBP-paid), and $700,000. A Leadership Council was also formed. Watch for further board succession and governance shifts.
